  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Cook the {{ing_01|peas}} with {{ing_02|oil}} and a {{ing_03|piece of sow’s belly}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Put in a sauce pan {{ing_04|broth}}, {{ing_05|leek heads}} [the lower white part] {{ing_06|green coriander}} and put on the fire to be cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Of {{ing_07|tid-bits}} cut little dice."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Similarly cook {{ing_08|thrushes or other small [game] birds}}, or take {{ing_09|sliced chicken and diced brain}}, properly cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Further cook, in the available liquor or {{ing_04|broth}}, {{ing_10|Lucanian sausage}} and {{ing_11|bacon}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Cook {{ing_12|leeks}} in water."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_13|1 pint of toasted pignolia nuts (crushed)}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Also crush {{ing_14|pepper}}, {{ing_15|lovage}}, {{ing_16|origany}} and {{ing_17|ginger}}, dilute with the {{ing_04|broth}} of pork, tie [4]."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Take a square baking dish suitable for turning over which {{ing_02|oil}} well and line with {{ing_24|caul}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 10,
      "text": "Sprinkle [on the bottom] a layer of {{ing_13|crushed nuts}} upon which put some {{ing_01|peas}}, fully covering the bottom of the squash dish."
    },
    {
      "step": 11,
      "text": "On top of this arrange slices of the {{ing_11|bacon}} {{ing_12|leeks}} and sliced {{ing_10|Lucanian sausage}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 12,
      "text": "Again cover with a layer of {{ing_01|peas}} and alternate all the rest of the available edibles in the manner described until the dish is filled, concluding at last with a layer of {{ing_01|peas}}, utilizing everything."
    },
    {
      "step": 13,
      "text": "Bake this dish in the oven, or put it into a slow fire [covering it with live coal] so that it may be baked thoroughly."
    },
    {
      "step": 14,
      "text": "[Next make a sauce of the following] Put {{ing_18|yolks of hard boiled eggs}} in the mortar with {{ing_19|white pepper}}, {{ing_20|nuts}}, {{ing_21|honey}}, {{ing_22|white wine}} and {{ing_23|a little broth}}; mix and put it into a sauce pan to be cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 15,
      "text": "When [the sauce is] done, turn out the {{ing_01|peas}} into a large [silver dish] and mask them with this sauce which is called white sauce [7]."
    }
  ],
